summary.text: Dustin McNally is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 42 (Grand Forks) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Dustin McNally's service as "House since 2025". The member page lists Dustin McNally's committee assignments as including the Energy Development and Transmission Committee (interim).
